interpretation: Neither source-year shoot density nor blade length robustly improves next-year focal-frequency prediction beyond current frequency, Braun-Blanquet abundance, stable node identity, year, visits, and condition-measurement effort. The Tampa state hierarchy is therefore not supported as a simple annual condition-to-occupancy cascade under this design.
ecological_boundary: Plant condition is more temporally labile than occurrence/abundance, but those state dimensions need not form a single serial degradation sequence. They may respond in parallel to local meadow state or different stress pathways.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc exploratory state-cascade test; not independent confirmation.
A null annual cascade does not imply blade length or shoot density are ecologically irrelevant.
Negative predictive coefficients should not be interpreted causally because current frequency/abundance and site identity are conditioned on.
Do not retune lags, condition transforms, target state, or baseline after this result to manufacture a serial cascade.
